cn-20261118-news-1.title: The Second Year of 'Anti-Involution': Has the Price War Cooled Down? Assessing Policy Effectiveness via PPI, Profits, and Payment Terms

segments.src: 从2025年年中提出“综合整治内卷式竞争”算起,这项治理已持续一年多。比较稳妥的判断是:**部分行业的无序低价明显收敛,价格降幅在收窄,但全面回暖还需要时间。** 各行业的进度并不一致,更不能把“价格降幅收窄”直接等同于“需求强劲复苏”。
segments.tr: Since the proposal to "comprehensively rectify involutionary competition" was introduced in mid-2025, this governance has been ongoing for over a year. A prudent judgment is: **The disorderly low-price competition in some industries has clearly converged, and the magnitude of price declines is narrowing, but a comprehensive recovery still takes time.** The progress across industries is inconsistent, and one certainly cannot equate "narrowing price declines" directly with "strong demand recovery."

segments.src: > 说明:本文用于信息梳理,不构成投资建议。文中涉及的具体数据,请以国家统计局、行业协会及企业公告的最新发布为准。
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for information synthesis purposes and does not constitute investment advice. For specific data mentioned in the text, please refer to the latest releases from the National Bureau of Statistics, industry associations, and corporate announcements.

segments.src: “内卷式”价格竞争,通常指企业在供给过剩、需求不足时,不断降价甚至低于成本销售,以换取份额。它有几个典型表现:
segments.tr: "Involutionary" price competition usually refers to companies continuously lowering prices, sometimes even selling below cost, to gain market share when supply is excessive and demand is insufficient. It has several typical manifestations:

segments.src: - 价格长期低于合理成本,企业利润被持续压缩;
segments.tr: - Prices are consistently below reasonable costs, and corporate profits are continuously compressed;

segments.src: - 为压低成本而削减研发、服务或质量投入;
segments.tr: - Cutting investment in R&D, service, or quality to lower costs;

segments.src: - 对上游供应商拖长付款周期,把压力向产业链传导;
segments.tr: - Extending payment cycles to upstream suppliers, shifting pressure down the supply chain;

segments.src: - 部分产能无法出清,形成“越亏越产、越产越亏”的循环。
segments.tr: - Some production capacity cannot be cleared, forming a cycle of "the more you lose, the more you produce; the more you produce, the more you lose."

segments.src: 这类竞争短期内让消费者受益,长期却可能损害产品质量、创新能力和就业稳定。这也是政策强调“规范价格秩序”而非“禁止降价”的原因:正常的成本下降、技术进步带来的降价仍然受到鼓励。
segments.tr: This type of competition benefits consumers in the short term but may damage product quality, innovation capability, and employment stability in the long term. This is also why policy emphasizes "regulating price order" rather than "banning price cuts": price reductions resulting from normal cost decreases or technological progress are still encouraged.

segments.src: ## 二、政策脉络:从表态到制度
segments.tr: ## II. Policy Context: From Stance to System

segments.src: - **2025年年中**:高层会议明确要求依法依规治理企业无序“内卷式”竞争,引导企业提升产品品质,推动落后产能有序退出。
segments.tr: - **Mid-2025**: High-level meetings explicitly required the governance of disorderly "involutionary" competition among enterprises in accordance with laws and regulations, guiding companies to improve product quality and promoting the orderly exit of backward production capacity.

segments.src: - **法律层面**:修订《反不正当竞争法》《价格法》等,明确不得以低于成本的价格倾销扰乱市场,也完善了对平台经营者的规范。
segments.tr: - **Legal Level**: Revising the "Anti-Unfair Competition Law," the "Price Law," etc., to clarify that dumping at prices below cost to disrupt the market is prohibited, and to improve regulations for platform operators.

segments.src: - **行业层面**:汽车、光伏、钢铁、电解铝、水泥等产能过剩领域,陆续出台产能调控、行业自律和规范竞争的举措;汽车行业还对供应商支付账期作出明确承诺。
segments.tr: - **Industry Level**: In overcapacity sectors such as automobiles, photovoltaics, steel, electrolytic aluminum, and cement, measures for capacity regulation, industry self-discipline, and standardized competition have been introduced successively; the automotive industry has also made clear commitments regarding payment terms for suppliers.

segments.src: - **平台经济**:针对外卖平台补贴大战,监管部门约谈相关企业,要求理性竞争、规范促销。
segments.tr: - **Platform Economy**: Regarding the subsidy war on food delivery platforms, regulatory authorities have held talks with relevant companies, requiring rational competition and standardized promotions.

segments.src: PPI(工业生产者出厂价格指数)已多年处于同比负值区间,是观察工业品价格压力最直接的指标。看PPI时,建议关注三点:
segments.tr: The PPI (Producer Price Index) has been in negative year-on-year territory for many years and is the most direct indicator for observing industrial product price pressure. When looking at PPI, it is recommended to focus on three points:

segments.src: 1. **同比降幅是否持续收窄**,这是价格压力缓解的初步信号;
segments.tr: 1. **Whether the year-on-year decline continues to narrow**, which is an initial signal of easing price pressure;

segments.src: 2. **环比是否转正并能延续**,比同比更能反映当期变化;
segments.tr: 2. **Whether the month-on-month rate turns positive and can be sustained**, which reflects current changes better than year-on-year data;

segments.src: 3. **上游原材料与下游消费品是否同步改善**,若只有大宗商品带动,持续性需要观察。
segments.tr: 3. **Whether upstream raw materials and downstream consumer goods are improving simultaneously**; if only driven by commodities, sustainability needs to be observed.

segments.src: 需要注意:PPI受国际大宗商品、基数效应等因素影响很大,不能把它全部归功于政策。
segments.tr: It should be noted: PPI is heavily influenced by international commodities, base effects, and other factors, so one cannot attribute it entirely to policy.

segments.src: ### 2. 工业企业利润:价格回升有没有转化为盈利
segments.tr: ### 2. Industrial Enterprise Profits: Has Price Recovery Translated into Profitability?

segments.src: 价格企稳只是第一步,利润才是检验。分析时可关注:
segments.tr: Price stabilization is only the first step; profit is the test. When analyzing, one can focus on:

segments.src: - **利润率**是否改善,而不仅是利润总额;
segments.tr: - Whether **profit margins** have improved, not just total profits;

segments.src: - **上游与下游**的利润分配是否更均衡;
segments.tr: - Whether the profit distribution between **upstream and downstream** is more balanced;
- Whether the **scope of losses** has narrowed.

segments.src: 若价格回升但成本同步上升,利润未必改善;反之,即使价格持平,费用压降也可能带来利润修复。
segments.tr: If prices rise but costs rise simultaneously, profits may not improve; conversely, even if prices remain flat, cost reductions may lead to profit restoration.

segments.src: ### 3. 企业账期:被忽视的“隐性内卷”
segments.tr: ### 3. Corporate Payment Terms: The Overlooked "Hidden Involution"

segments.src: 应收账款周转天数、对供应商的付款期限,是衡量产业链健康度的重要线索。大企业拖欠中小供应商货款,本质上是把竞争压力转嫁给产业链下游。**付款周期能否缩短,是判断治理是否“真落地”的重要观察点**,也直接关系到中小企业的现金流。
segments.tr: Accounts receivable turnover days and payment deadlines to suppliers are important clues for measuring the health of the industrial chain. Large enterprises delaying payments to small and medium-sized suppliers essentially shift competitive pressure to the downstream of the industrial chain. **Whether payment cycles can be shortened is an important observation point for judging whether governance has "truly landed,"** and it is also directly related to the cash flow of small and medium-sized enterprises.

segments.src: ### 汽车:价格战降温,但竞争并未消失
segments.tr: ### Automobiles: Price War Cooled, but Competition Has Not Disappeared

segments.src: 汽车行业是“反内卷”的焦点。年内多家车企承诺缩短供应商付款周期,监管部门也对“零公里二手车”、不当降价促销等行为加强规范。从市场表现看,大幅“官降”的频率较此前有所下降,促销转向金融贴息、权益赠送等形式。
segments.tr: The automotive industry is the focus of "anti-involution." Within the year, many car companies promised to shorten payment cycles to suppliers, and regulatory authorities also strengthened regulations on behaviors such as "zero-kilometer used cars" and improper price-cutting promotions. From market performance, the frequency of significant "official price cuts" has decreased compared to before, and promotions have shifted to forms such as financial subsidies and equity gifts.

segments.src: 但需要看到:行业产能利用率、新能源车渗透提升带来的结构性竞争仍在,海外市场拓展也让竞争外溢。因此更准确的说法是“从明面价格战转向更规范的竞争”,而非“竞争消失”。
segments.tr: However, it is necessary to see: structural competition brought about by industry capacity utilization and the increased penetration of new energy vehicles still exists, and overseas market expansion has also caused competition to spill over. Therefore, a more accurate statement is **"shifting from overt price wars to more standardized competition"** rather than "competition has disappeared."

segments.src: ### 光伏:出清是关键,过程较为漫长
segments.tr: ### Photovoltaics: Clearing is Key, the Process is Relatively Long

segments.src: 光伏产业链(多晶硅、硅片、电池片、组件)曾因严重产能过剩出现全行业亏损。治理思路是限制低价竞争、推动产能整合与落后产能退出。相关环节价格出现过阶段性反弹,说明规范价格对预期有提振作用。
segments.tr: The photovoltaic industry chain (polysilicon, silicon wafers, cells, modules) once experienced industry-wide losses due to severe overcapacity. The governance approach is to restrict low-price competition and promote capacity integration and the exit of backward capacity. Prices in relevant segments have seen periodic rebounds, indicating that regulating prices has a boosting effect on expectations.

segments.src: 不过,价格回升若不能伴随真实需求和有效的产能出清,就可能反复。该行业仍处于“修复早期、基础尚未稳固”的阶段,需要继续观察库存、开工率和企业现金流。
segments.tr: However, if price recovery cannot be accompanied by real demand and effective capacity clearing, it may repeat. This industry is still in the stage of **"early repair, foundation not yet solidified,"** and it is necessary to continue to observe inventory, operating rates, and corporate cash flow.

segments.src: ### 外卖及即时零售:补贴退潮,规则趋于规范
segments.tr: ### Food Delivery and Instant Retail: Subsidies Recede, Rules Become Standardized

segments.src: 平台之间的高额补贴竞争一度推高了成本,也引发商家、骑手和监管层面的关注。在监管提醒后,大规模补贴有所收敛,平台更多强调履约质量与规范运营。
segments.tr: High-subsidy competition between platforms once drove up costs and also attracted attention from merchants, riders, and regulators. After regulatory reminders, large-scale subsidies have converged, and platforms emphasize fulfillment quality and standardized operations more.

segments.src: 对商家而言,关键是平台佣金、促销分摊规则是否更透明;对骑手而言,则是权益保障是否到位。这一领域的竞争本质是平台生态之争,**补贴退潮不等于竞争结束**,后续仍取决于监管常态化与平台策略。
segments.tr: For merchants, the key is whether platform commissions and promotion sharing rules are more transparent; for riders, it is whether rights protection is in place. The essence of competition in this field is the battle of platform ecosystems; **the receding of subsidies does not equal the end of competition**, and the follow-up still depends on the normalization of regulation and platform strategies.

segments.src: ### 上游传统行业:钢铁、水泥、煤炭等
segments.tr: ### Upstream Traditional Industries: Steel, Cement, Coal, etc.

segments.src: 这类行业的核心问题是产能与需求的匹配。价格受房地产、基建需求影响较大,“反内卷”主要通过产能调控、错峰生产、限制低价倾销来发挥作用。改善幅度取决于需求端的恢复,因此**压力缓解较慢,分化也较大**。
segments.tr: The core problem of such industries is the matching of capacity and demand. Prices are heavily influenced by real estate and infrastructure demand, and "anti-involution" mainly plays a role through capacity regulation, peak-shifting production, and restricting low-price dumping. The extent of improvement depends on the recovery of the demand side, so **pressure relief is slower, and differentiation is also greater**.

segments.src: ## 五、对普通消费者意味着什么
segments.tr: ## V. What Does It Mean for Ordinary Consumers?

segments.src: - **价格:** 极端低价、“补贴大战”式的促销会减少,但不代表物价会明显上涨,多数消费品的价格仍受竞争和需求约束。
segments.tr: - **Prices:** Extreme low prices and "subsidy war" style promotions will decrease, but this does not mean that prices will rise significantly; the prices of most consumer goods are still constrained by competition and demand.

segments.src: - **品质与服务:** 企业不再单靠压价竞争,长期看有利于质量、售后和创新。
segments.tr: - **Quality and Service:** Enterprises will no longer rely solely on price-cutting competition, which is conducive to quality, after-sales service, and innovation in the long run.

segments.src: - **消费建议:** 对异常低价、来源不明的商品保持警惕;购买大件商品时,更多比较质保、服务和综合成本,而不只看“最低价”。
segments.tr: - **Consumption Advice:** Be vigilant about abnormally low-priced goods of unknown origin; when purchasing large items, compare warranties, services, and comprehensive costs more, rather than just looking at the "lowest price."

segments.src: ## 六、对投资者的理性提示
1. **区分“价格企稳”与“盈利改善”**:前者可能先发生,后者需要成本、销量共同配合。
segments.tr: 1. **Distinguish between "price stabilization" and "profit improvement"**: The former may happen first, while the latter requires the cooperation of costs and sales volume.

segments.src: 2. **关注现金流与负债**:在出清阶段,财务稳健的企业更有韧性。
segments.tr: 2. **Focus on cash flow and debt**: In the clearing stage, financially sound companies are more resilient.

segments.src: 3. **避免简单化的“政策主题”思维**:不同行业的供需格局差别很大,同一政策的影响并不一致。
segments.tr: 3. **Avoid simplistic "policy theme" thinking**: The supply and demand patterns of different industries vary greatly, and the impact of the same policy is not consistent.

segments.src: 4. **关注政策边界**:治理的目标是规范无序竞争,而不是保护落后产能,也不是限制正常的市场竞争。
segments.tr: 4. **Focus on policy boundaries**: The goal of governance is to regulate disorderly competition, not to protect backward capacity, nor to restrict normal market competition.

segments.src: 投资有风险,具体决策请结合自身情况,并参考专业机构意见。
segments.tr: Investment involves risks; please combine your own situation with specific decisions and refer to the opinions of professional institutions.
## VII. Challenges That Still Need Attention

segments.src: - **需求端偏弱**:若居民消费和投资需求恢复不足,单靠供给侧约束难以根本改变供大于求的局面。
segments.tr: - **Weak Demand Side**: If the recovery of household consumption and investment demand is insufficient, relying solely on supply-side constraints cannot fundamentally change the situation of supply exceeding demand.

segments.src: - **地方与企业的执行**:产能退出会涉及就业、税收与债务,需要稳妥推进。
segments.tr: - **Execution by Local Governments and Enterprises**: Capacity exit will involve employment, taxation, and debt, which needs to be promoted prudently.

segments.src: - **“一刀切”风险**:过度干预可能抑制正常的价格竞争和技术进步,需要在规范与活力之间保持平衡。
segments.tr: - **"One-size-fits-all" Risk**: Excessive intervention may inhibit normal price competition and technological progress, requiring a balance between regulation and vitality.

segments.src: - **出口外溢**:国内竞争加剧时,产能可能转向海外,引发贸易摩擦。
segments.tr: - **Export Spillover**: When domestic competition intensifies, capacity may shift overseas, triggering trade frictions.

segments.src: “反内卷”走到第二年,最大的变化可能不是某个指数的数值,而是**市场对“低于成本竞争不可持续”形成了更清晰的共识**。汽车行业的价格与账期规范、光伏的产能整合、平台补贴的收敛,都是积极的信号。
segments.tr: As "anti-involution" enters its second year, the biggest change may not be the value of a certain index, but that **the market has formed a clearer consensus that "competition below cost is unsustainable."** The standardization of prices and payment terms in the automotive industry, the integration of photovoltaic capacity, and the convergence of platform subsidies are all positive signals.

segments.src: 但从PPI到企业利润,再到产业链账期,改善仍是渐进的、分化的。判断政策成效,不应只看一个月的数据,而要持续观察**价格、利润、现金流、产能利用率**这几条线能否同步向好。对于消费者和投资者而言,保持理性、关注长期趋势,比追逐短期波动更为重要。
segments.tr: However, from PPI to corporate profits, and then to industrial chain payment terms, improvement is still gradual and differentiated. Judging the effectiveness of policies should not just look at one month's data, but continuously observe whether the lines of **prices, profits, cash flow, and capacity utilization** can improve simultaneously. For consumers and investors, maintaining rationality and focusing on long-term trends is more important than chasing short-term fluctuations.

cn-20261118-news-2.title: Amidst Fluctuating International Oil Prices: Understanding Refined Oil Price Adjustment Windows and Calculating Costs for Car Owners, Logistics, and Air Travel

segments.src: 年末临近,不少人发现加油站的价格牌隔几天就变一次,新闻里也常出现"油价上调""油价下调"的字样。这背后既有国际原油市场的波动,也有国内成品油定价机制的传导。本文用通俗的方式梳理三件事:国际油价为什么会波动,国内调价窗口怎么运作,以及价格变化对不同出行方式的成本大致有多大影响。
segments.tr: As the end of the year approaches, many people notice that the price boards at gas stations change every few days, and news headlines frequently feature terms like "oil price hike" or "oil price cut." Behind this lies both the volatility of the international crude oil market and the transmission mechanism of domestic refined oil pricing. This article uses a simple approach to clarify three things: why international oil prices fluctuate, how domestic price adjustment windows operate, and roughly how much price changes affect the costs of different modes of travel.

segments.src: > 说明:本文为知识性科普,文中数字为便于理解的示例估算,不代表对未来油价的预测,也不构成任何投资或消费建议。具体调价幅度与时间,请以国家发展改革委等官方发布为准。
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for educational purposes. The figures used are estimated examples for ease of understanding and do not represent predictions of future oil prices, nor do they constitute any investment or consumption advice. For specific price adjustment ranges and timing, please refer to official announcements from the National Development and Reform Commission and other authorities.

segments.src: ## 一、国际油价为什么会波动
segments.tr: ## I. Why Do International Oil Prices Fluctuate?

segments.src: 国际原油价格由供给、需求和市场预期共同决定,常见的影响因素包括:
segments.tr: International crude oil prices are determined by supply, demand, and market expectations. Common influencing factors include:

segments.src: 1. **产油国的产量政策。** 欧佩克及其合作伙伴(通常简称"OPEC+")会根据市场情况讨论增产、减产或维持产量。产量预期变化,往往会先反映在期货价格上。
segments.tr: 1. **Production policies of oil-producing countries.** OPEC and its partners (often referred to as "OPEC+") discuss increasing, decreasing, or maintaining production based on market conditions. Changes in production expectations are often reflected in futures prices first.

segments.src: 2. **全球需求预期。** 主要经济体的增长速度、工业活动、冬季取暖与出行需求,都会影响市场对原油消费量的判断。
segments.tr: 2. **Global demand expectations.** The growth rates of major economies, industrial activity, winter heating, and travel demand all influence the market's assessment of crude oil consumption.

segments.src: 3. **库存与运输。** 商业库存的变化、航运和炼厂检修等,会影响短期供需平衡。
segments.tr: 3. **Inventory and transportation.** Changes in commercial inventories, shipping, and refinery maintenance affect short-term supply and demand balance.

segments.src: 4. **汇率与市场情绪。** 原油以美元计价,美元汇率变化和资金情绪也会带来短期波动。
segments.tr: 4. **Exchange rates and market sentiment.** Crude oil is priced in USD; changes in the USD exchange rate and market sentiment can also lead to short-term volatility.

segments.src: 需要强调的是,这些因素常常同时作用、相互抵消,单一消息很难决定价格的长期走势。因此,普通消费者更适合了解规则、做好预算,而不是押注某一次涨跌。
segments.tr: It is important to emphasize that these factors often act simultaneously and offset each other; it is difficult for a single piece of news to determine the long-term trend of prices. Therefore, it is more suitable for ordinary consumers to understand the rules and budget accordingly, rather than betting on any single rise or fall.

segments.src: ## 二、国内成品油调价机制:窗口期怎么算
segments.tr: ## II. Domestic Refined Oil Price Adjustment Mechanism: How Are Windows Calculated?

segments.src: 我国成品油(汽油、柴油)价格实行政府指导价,国内价格与国际原油价格挂钩。公开的主要规则可以概括为:
segments.tr: China's refined oil (gasoline, diesel) prices are subject to government-guided pricing, and domestic prices are linked to international crude oil prices. The main public rules can be summarized as follows:

segments.src: - **调价周期:每10个工作日一个窗口。** 到了窗口期,有关部门会参考此前一段时间国际原油的平均价格变化,计算国内汽、柴油最高零售价是否调整。
segments.tr: - **Adjustment cycle: A window every 10 working days.** When the window period arrives, relevant departments will calculate whether the maximum retail prices for domestic gasoline and diesel should be adjusted by referencing the average price changes of international crude oil over the previous period.

segments.src: - **变化幅度的门槛。** 当测算的价格变化幅度很小(规则中有每吨50元的门槛说法)时,当次不调整,变化会累积到下一个窗口。这就是有时"搁浅"的原因。
segments.tr: - **Threshold for price changes.** When the calculated price change is very small (the rule includes a threshold of 50 yuan per ton), no adjustment is made for that period, and the change is accumulated to the next window. This is why adjustments are sometimes "stranded."

segments.src: - **价格上下限。** 机制中设有高限和低限的保护安排:国际油价过高时,国内价格不会完全跟随上涨;过低时,也会有相应安排。
segments.tr: - **Price caps and floors.** The mechanism includes protection arrangements with upper and lower limits: when international oil prices are too high, domestic prices will not fully follow the rise; when they are too low, there are corresponding arrangements.

segments.src: - **执行时间。** 调整一般在窗口期最后一天24时生效,所以有人会在"调价日"前后选择加油时间。
segments.tr: - **Execution time.** Adjustments generally take effect at 24:00 on the last day of the window period, which is why some people choose to refuel around the "price adjustment day."

segments.src: 简单说,国内油价不是"国际一涨就涨",而是按周期、按平均值、带门槛地传导,因此变化比期货市场更平缓,也有一定滞后。
segments.tr: In short, domestic oil prices do not "rise as soon as international prices rise," but are transmitted according to cycles, averages, and thresholds. Therefore, changes are smoother than in the futures market and have a certain lag.

segments.src: ## 三、"每吨涨多少"如何换算成"每升涨多少"
segments.tr: ## III. How to Convert "Price Increase per Ton" to "Price Increase per Liter"

segments.src: 新闻里通常用"元/吨"报道调价幅度,而我们加油是按"升"计价。换算时可以使用一个粗略的参考:
segments.tr: News reports usually report price adjustments in "yuan/ton," while we pay for fuel by the "liter." You can use a rough reference for conversion:

segments.src: - 汽油:每吨大约相当于1350至1400升(随标号略有差异)。
segments.tr: - Gasoline: One ton is approximately equivalent to 1350 to 1400 liters (varies slightly by grade).

segments.src: - 柴油:每吨大约相当于1150至1200升。
segments.tr: - Diesel: One ton is approximately equivalent to 1150 to 1200 liters.

segments.src: - 汽油每吨变动100元,折合每升约0.07至0.08元。
segments.tr: - A change of 100 yuan per ton for gasoline is equivalent to about 0.07 to 0.08 yuan per liter.

segments.src: - 柴油每吨变动100元,折合每升约0.08至0.09元。
segments.tr: - A change of 100 yuan per ton for diesel is equivalent to about 0.08 to 0.09 yuan per liter.

segments.src: 例如,一次调价为每吨上涨300元,汽油每升大约多0.22元左右,柴油每升大约多0.25元左右。
segments.tr: For example, if a price adjustment is an increase of 300 yuan per ton, gasoline increases by about 0.22 yuan per liter, and diesel increases by about 0.25 yuan per liter.

segments.src: ## 四、对三类出行成本的估算
segments.tr: ## IV. Estimation of Costs for Three Types of Travel

segments.src: 以下为示例估算,方便你建立数量级概念,实际结果因车型、路况、驾驶习惯等而异。
segments.tr: The following are estimated examples to help you establish a sense of magnitude. Actual results vary depending on vehicle model, road conditions, driving habits, etc.

segments.src: 假设油箱容量为50升,某次调价使汽油每升变化0.30元:
segments.tr: Assuming a fuel tank capacity of 50 liters and a price adjustment that changes gasoline by 0.30 yuan per liter:
- Difference for a full tank: 50 × 0.30 = **15 yuan**.

segments.src: - 假设一年行驶15000公里,百公里油耗8升,则年耗油约1200升,全年差额约 1200 × 0.30 = **360元**,折合每月约30元。
segments.tr: - Assuming an annual mileage of 15,000 kilometers and a fuel consumption of 8 liters per 100 kilometers, the annual fuel consumption is about 1200 liters, and the annual difference is about 1200 × 0.30 = **360 yuan**, which is about 30 yuan per month.

segments.src: 结论:单次调价对一辆家用车影响有限,但如果价格长期处于较高水平,累积影响会更明显。控制油耗的小办法包括:保持合适胎压、减少急加速急刹车、及时清理后备厢杂物、合理规划路线等。
segments.tr: Conclusion: A single price adjustment has a limited impact on a family car, but if prices remain at a high level for a long time, the cumulative impact will be more significant. Small ways to control fuel consumption include: maintaining proper tire pressure, reducing sudden acceleration and braking, clearing out unnecessary items from the trunk, and planning routes reasonably.

segments.src: 柴油是公路货运的重要成本项。假设一辆重型货车百公里油耗约35升,年行驶10万公里:
segments.tr: Diesel is a significant cost item for road freight. Assuming a heavy truck has a fuel consumption of about 35 liters per 100 kilometers and an annual mileage of 100,000 kilometers:
- Annual fuel consumption is about 35,000 liters;
- If diesel changes by 0.30 yuan per liter, the annual fuel expenditure changes by about 35,000 × 0.30 = **10,500 yuan**.

segments.src: 燃油通常占货运运营成本中相当大的比例。物流企业常见的应对方式有:优化配载与路线、使用油耗管理系统,以及在运价中设置"燃油联动"条款,让运费随油价按约定方式浮动。不过,这类成本最终是否传导到商品价格,还取决于竞争与市场环境。
segments.tr: Fuel usually accounts for a significant proportion of logistics operating costs. Common ways for logistics companies to cope include: optimizing loads and routes, using fuel consumption management systems, and setting "fuel linkage" clauses in freight rates to allow freight rates to fluctuate with oil prices in an agreed manner. However, whether such costs are ultimately passed on to commodity prices depends on competition and the market environment.

segments.src: 航空公司的燃料是航空煤油,其价格同样与国际原油价格关联。对旅客而言,影响主要体现在两个方面:
segments.tr: The fuel for airlines is aviation kerosene, and its price is also linked to international crude oil prices. For passengers, the impact is mainly reflected in two aspects:

segments.src: - **燃油附加费。** 国内航线的燃油附加费通常与航空煤油价格按规则联动,并按公布的周期调整;国际航线则按各航空公司和航线规则执行。购票时,请留意票价明细里的"燃油附加费"一项。
segments.tr: - **Fuel surcharges.** Fuel surcharges for domestic routes are usually linked to aviation kerosene prices according to rules and adjusted according to announced cycles; international routes are executed according to the rules of each airline and route. When purchasing tickets, please pay attention to the "fuel surcharge" item in the ticket price details.

segments.src: - **票价与运力安排。** 燃油是航空公司的主要成本之一,但机票价格还受季节、节假日、供需和竞争影响,油价只是其中一个因素。
segments.tr: - **Ticket prices and capacity arrangements.** Fuel is one of the main costs for airlines, but ticket prices are also affected by seasons, holidays, supply and demand, and competition; oil prices are just one factor.

segments.src: 对旅客来说,提前购票、灵活选择出行日期、比较含税总价,往往比猜测油价走势更实用。
segments.tr: For passengers, booking tickets in advance, flexibly choosing travel dates, and comparing total prices including taxes are often more practical than guessing oil price trends.
## V. What Can Ordinary People Do?

segments.src: 1. **了解规则,不必恐慌。** 知道调价窗口的周期和门槛,就不会被零散消息牵着走。
segments.tr: 1. **Understand the rules, no need to panic.** Knowing the cycle and threshold of the price adjustment window means you won't be swayed by scattered news.

segments.src: 2. **用"总账"看成本。** 与其盯着一次的几元差价,不如关注全年用车、通勤方式和路线规划带来的总体支出。
segments.tr: 2. **Look at costs with a "general ledger."** Instead of staring at a few yuan difference in a single adjustment, it is better to focus on the overall expenditure brought about by annual car usage, commuting methods, and route planning.

segments.src: 3. **理性对待"囤油"说法。** 油品有安全存放要求,私自大量囤积既不安全,也可能违反规定,不建议这样做。
segments.tr: 3. **Treat the "hoarding oil" talk rationally.** Oil products have safety storage requirements. Hoarding large quantities privately is not only unsafe but may also violate regulations, so it is not recommended.

segments.src: 4. **优先使用权威信息。** 调价信息请以官方渠道发布为准,对未经证实的"内部消息"保持警惕。
segments.tr: 4. **Prioritize authoritative information.** Please rely on official channels for price adjustment information and remain vigilant against unverified "insider news."

segments.src: 国际油价受产油国政策与全球需求预期影响,出现波动是常态;国内的调价窗口机制则是把这种波动以更平缓、有节奏的方式传导到加油站。读懂"每吨"与"每升"的换算,再结合自己的用车情况做一次简单测算,就能比较清楚地判断油价变化对自己的真实影响,从而更从容地安排出行和预算。
segments.tr: International oil prices are affected by the policies of oil-producing countries and global demand expectations, and fluctuations are the norm; the domestic price adjustment window mechanism transmits this volatility to gas stations in a smoother, more rhythmic way. By understanding the conversion between "per ton" and "per liter," and then making a simple calculation based on your own car usage, you can more clearly judge the real impact of oil price changes on yourself, thereby arranging your travel and budget more calmly.

cn-20261118-consumer-advertising-psychol.title: [Consumer & Advertising Psychology #9] You Thought It Was a "Sudden Urge to Buy," But Your Brain Had Already Gone Through Three Steps

segments.src: > 一次购买很少是"一时冲动"那么简单：先发现缺口，再找信息，然后在几个选项里比较——广告在每一步都有不同的切入点。
segments.tr: > A purchase is rarely just a "momentary impulse": first you notice a gap, then you look for information, then you compare several options. Advertising has a different entry point at each step.

segments.src: 消费者心理学里有一个经典框架，把购买决策大致分成五个阶段：**问题认知 → 信息搜索 → 方案评估 → 购买决策 → 购后评价**。这个思路常和 EKB 模型（恩格尔-科拉特-布莱克威尔模型）联系在一起。今天只讲前三步，因为它们发生在掏钱之前，也是广告最常发力的地方。
segments.tr: Consumer psychology has a classic framework that breaks the purchase decision into five stages: **Problem Recognition → Information Search → Alternative Evaluation → Purchase Decision → Post-Purchase Evaluation**. This idea is often linked with the EKB model (Engel-Kollat-Blackwell model). Today we only cover the first three steps, because they happen before money changes hands, and they are where advertising most often applies force.

segments.src: 决策的起点不是"看到商品"，而是意识到一个**缺口**：现在的状态和想要的状态之间有落差。落差可能来自内部，比如饿了、手机卡了；也可能来自外部，比如看到同事换了新耳机，或者广告让你注意到"原来家里的空气可以更干净"。要注意的是，广告通常无法凭空制造需求，它做的往往是**让一个原本模糊的缺口变得清晰、变得急迫**。
segments.tr: The starting point of a decision is not "seeing a product" but becoming aware of a **gap**: a difference between your current state and the state you want. The gap may come from within, such as being hungry or your phone lagging; it may also come from outside, such as seeing a coworker switch to new headphones, or an ad making you notice that "the air at home could be cleaner." Note that advertising usually cannot create needs out of thin air. What it does is often **make a previously vague gap clear and urgent**.

segments.src: 意识到问题后，人会去找解决办法。搜索分两种：
segments.tr: Once a problem is recognized, people look for solutions. Searching comes in two kinds:

segments.src: - **内部搜索**：从记忆里调取。"上次买的那个牌子还不错"。
segments.tr: - **Internal search**: retrieving from memory. "The brand we bought last time was pretty good."

segments.src: - **外部搜索**：问朋友、看测评、刷评论区、去门店体验。
segments.tr: - **External search**: asking friends, reading reviews, scrolling comment sections, visiting stores to try things out.

segments.src: 搜索花多少力气，取决于"买错的代价"。一瓶矿泉水几乎不搜索；一台几千元的家电，人们可能会花好几个晚上研究。心理学上把这叫作**卷入度**：卷入度越高，搜索越深入。
segments.tr: How much effort goes into searching depends on "the cost of buying the wrong thing." Almost no searching is done for a bottle of mineral water; for an appliance costing several thousand yuan, people may spend several evenings researching. In psychology this is called **involvement**: the higher the involvement, the deeper the search.

segments.src: 人不会比较市场上所有的品牌，而是先在脑子里圈出一个小名单，叫作**考虑集**，通常只有几个品牌。没进入考虑集的品牌，基本连被比较的机会都没有——这也是品牌为什么愿意长期花钱"混个脸熟"。
segments.tr: People don't compare every brand on the market. Instead, they first narrow things down in their heads to a short list called the **consideration set**, usually just a few brands. Brands outside the consideration set basically never get a chance to be compared, which is why brands are willing to keep spending money to "stay familiar."

segments.src: 进入比较后，常见两类规则：
segments.tr: Once comparison begins, two common types of rules apply:

segments.src: - **补偿性规则**：各项指标综合打分，一项弱可以被另一项强弥补。"续航一般，但价格便宜很多，可以接受。"
segments.tr: - **Compensatory rules**: each attribute is scored and combined, so a weakness in one area can be offset by strength in another. "Battery life is average, but it's much cheaper, so that's acceptable."

segments.src: - **非补偿性规则**：设定硬门槛，不达标直接淘汰。"噪音超过某个值的一律不要。"
segments.tr: - **Non-compensatory rules**: set hard thresholds; anything that fails is eliminated outright. "Anything with noise above a certain level is out."

segments.src: 现实中，人们常常先用硬门槛筛掉大部分选项，再对剩下的几个做综合比较。
segments.tr: In reality, people often first use hard thresholds to filter out most options, then make an overall comparison among the few that remain.

segments.src: 小林在上海租房，养了一只猫。最近总是在沙发缝里清出猫毛，下班后还要扫地，越来越烦——**问题认知**出现了：现状（每天手动打扫）和理想状态（回家就是干净的）之间有了落差。恰好这周刷短视频时，好几次刷到扫地机器人吸猫毛的画面，这个念头被进一步放大。
segments.tr: Xiao Lin rents an apartment in Shanghai and has a cat. Lately he keeps finding cat hair in the sofa crevices, and after work he has to sweep, growing more and more annoyed. **Problem recognition** has kicked in: there is a gap between the current state (cleaning by hand every day) and the ideal state (coming home to a clean home). Coincidentally, this week his short-video feed has repeatedly shown robot vacuums picking up cat hair, and this thought was amplified further.

segments.src: 接着是**信息搜索**。小林先想起朋友家用的那台（内部搜索），然后去小红书搜"养猫 扫地机器人"，又在京东看了几款的问答区和差评（外部搜索）。因为预算在 2000 到 3000 元之间，不算小钱，他前后看了将近一周。
segments.tr: Next comes **information search**. Xiao Lin first recalls the one his friend uses (internal search), then searches "cat owners robot vacuum" on Xiaohongshu, and reads the Q&A sections and negative reviews of several models on JD.com (external search). Because his budget is between 2,000 and 3,000 yuan, which is not a small sum, he spent nearly a week looking.

segments.src: 最后是**方案评估**。他的考虑集里只有 4 个品牌。先用硬门槛淘汰：不能自动集尘的不要，超出 3000 元的不要（非补偿性规则）。剩下两款，一款吸力更强，一款避障更好但贵 300 元。他想到家里有不少数据线和猫玩具，觉得避障值这 300 元（补偿性规则）。
segments.tr: Finally, **alternative evaluation**. His consideration set has only 4 brands. He first uses hard thresholds to eliminate: anything without automatic dust emptying is out, and anything over 3,000 yuan is out (non-compensatory rules). Two models remain: one has stronger suction, the other has better obstacle avoidance but costs 300 yuan more. Thinking that his home has quite a few data cables and cat toys, he decides obstacle avoidance is worth those 300 yuan (compensatory rules).

segments.src: 回头看，那几条短视频广告并没有替他做决定，但它们**放大了问题认知**，并且**让品牌进入了他的考虑集**——这正是广告在前三步最常扮演的角色。
segments.tr: Looking back, those short-video ads did not make the decision for him, but they **amplified his problem recognition** and **got the brand into his consideration set**. This is exactly the role advertising most often plays in the first three steps.

segments.src: 1. 购买决策通常从"意识到现状与理想之间的缺口"开始，广告主要是放大和唤起这个缺口。
segments.tr: 1. A purchase decision usually begins with "becoming aware of a gap between the current state and the ideal state"; advertising mainly amplifies and triggers this gap.

segments.src: 2. 信息搜索分内部（记忆）和外部（他人、测评、评论），买错代价越高，搜得越深。
segments.tr: 2. Information search is internal (memory) and external (others, reviews, comments); the higher the cost of a wrong purchase, the deeper people search.

segments.src: 3. 评估时人们只比较考虑集里的少数品牌，常先用硬门槛淘汰，再综合权衡剩下的选项。
segments.tr: 3. When evaluating, people compare only a few brands in their consideration set, often using hard thresholds to eliminate first, then weighing the remaining options holistically.

segments.src: **1.** 判断对错：根据问题认知的概念，广告最常见的作用是凭空创造一个消费者完全不存在的需求。（O / X）
segments.tr: **1.** True or false: According to the concept of problem recognition, the most common role of advertising is to create, out of thin air, a need that consumers do not have at all. (O / X)

segments.src: **2.** 下列哪种情况，消费者最可能进行深入的外部信息搜索？
segments.tr: **2.** In which situation is a consumer most likely to conduct deep external information search?

segments.src: 在便利店买一瓶矿泉水
segments.tr: Buying a bottle of mineral water at a convenience store

segments.src: 第一次给父母挑选一台约 8000 元的按摩椅
segments.tr: Choosing a massage chair costing about 8,000 yuan for one's parents for the first time

segments.src: 按习惯买常用牌子的牙膏
segments.tr: Buying toothpaste of a usual brand out of habit

segments.src: **3.** "只要价格超过 500 元就直接不考虑，剩下的再比较外观和口碑"，其中"超过 500 元直接不考虑"属于哪种评估规则？
segments.tr: **3.** "Anything priced above 500 yuan is immediately excluded; then compare appearance and reputation among the rest." Which type of evaluation rule does "anything above 500 yuan is immediately excluded" belong to?

segments.src: - **问题认知**：消费者察觉到现实状态与期望状态之间存在落差，从而产生购买动机的阶段。
segments.tr: - **Problem recognition**: the stage in which a consumer notices a gap between the actual state and the desired state, thereby generating purchase motivation.

segments.src: - **内部搜索 / 外部搜索**：前者从自己的记忆和经验中找信息，后者向他人、媒体、评论等外部来源找信息。
segments.tr: - **Internal search / external search**: the former looks for information from one's own memory and experience; the latter seeks information from external sources such as other people, media, and reviews.

segments.src: - **卷入度**：一次购买对消费者的重要程度和相关程度，卷入度越高，决策过程通常越谨慎。
segments.tr: - **Involvement**: how important and relevant a purchase is to the consumer; the higher the involvement, the more cautious the decision process usually is.

segments.src: - **考虑集**：消费者在做选择时实际会认真比较的少数几个品牌。
segments.tr: - **Consideration set**: the few brands a consumer actually compares seriously when making a choice.

segments.src: - **补偿性 / 非补偿性规则**：前者允许优点弥补缺点、综合打分；后者设硬性门槛，不达标直接淘汰。
segments.tr: - **Compensatory / non-compensatory rules**: the former allow strengths to offset weaknesses and are scored holistically; the latter set hard thresholds and eliminate anything that fails.

segments.src: X —— 广告更常做的是唤起或放大消费者已有但模糊的缺口，而不是凭空制造需求。2.
segments.tr: X — Advertising more commonly evokes or amplifies a vague gap consumers already have, rather than creating demand out of nothing. 2.

segments.src: B —— 价格高、不常买、买错代价大，属于高卷入购买，外部搜索最深入。3.
segments.tr: B — A high price, infrequent purchase, and high cost of a wrong choice make this a high-involvement purchase, where external search is deepest. 3.

segments.src: B —— 设定硬门槛、不达标直接淘汰，是非补偿性规则；之后对剩余选项综合比较才属于补偿性规则。*
segments.tr: B — Setting hard thresholds and eliminating anything that fails is a non-compensatory rule; only the subsequent holistic comparison of remaining options is compensatory.*

cn-20261118-news-3.title: Year-End Policy "Checklist": Before December, It's Best to Verify These Life-Related Matters in Advance

segments.src: 每到年末,各类法规、行业标准和民生政策往往会集中进入调整、衔接或落地的节点。与此同时,个人和家庭也正好面临年度结算、账户梳理和来年规划。
segments.tr: As the end of the year approaches, various regulations, industry standards, and livelihood policies often reach a point of adjustment, transition, or implementation. At the same time, individuals and families are also facing annual settlements, account reviews, and planning for the coming year.

segments.src: 需要先说明:具体政策的生效日期、适用范围和办理细则,会因地区、行业和个人情况而不同,请以国家及所在地政府部门、人社、税务、交管、银行等**官方渠道**发布的最新信息为准。本文不对某项具体条款做定论,只提供一份**可操作的自查思路**,帮助你在年底前把事情理清楚。
segments.tr: A note of clarification: The effective dates, scope of application, and processing details of specific policies vary by region, industry, and personal circumstances. Please refer to the latest information released by **official channels** such as national and local government departments, human resources and social security bureaus, tax authorities, traffic management departments, and banks. This article does not make definitive statements on specific clauses but provides an **actionable self-check framework** to help you get things in order before the end of the year.

segments.src: ## 一、消费领域:留意规则变化,保留好凭证
segments.tr: ## I. Consumption: Pay Attention to Rule Changes and Keep Records

segments.src: - 年底是促销和办卡的高峰。办理前,请确认退款规则、有效期、余额处理和商家经营风险。
segments.tr: - The end of the year is a peak time for promotions and card applications. Before signing up, please confirm refund policies, validity periods, balance handling, and merchant operational risks.

segments.src: - 对已有的自动续费订阅,逐项检查是否仍然需要,必要时在到期前关闭自动续费。
segments.tr: - For existing auto-renewal subscriptions, check each one to see if you still need them, and cancel auto-renewal before the expiration date if necessary.

segments.src: - 保留订单截图、发票、聊天记录和支付凭证,它们是后续维权的重要依据。
segments.tr: - Keep screenshots of orders, invoices, chat records, and payment vouchers; these are important evidence for future consumer rights protection.

segments.src: - 关注商品标签、价格标示、售后承诺等方面的最新规范,遇到争议可先与商家协商,再通过平台、12315 等正规渠道反映。
segments.tr: - Pay attention to the latest regulations regarding product labels, price markings, and after-sales commitments. If disputes arise, negotiate with the merchant first, then escalate through platforms or official channels like 12315.

segments.src: 积分、优惠券与卡内余额**
- 许多积分和优惠券有年度清零或到期时间,建议在年底前集中查看并合理使用,避免白白失效。
segments.tr: - Many points and coupons have annual expiration dates. It is recommended to check and use them reasonably before the end of the year to avoid them expiring in vain.

segments.src: ## 二、出行领域:证件、车辆与规则要提前核对
segments.tr: ## II. Travel: Verify Documents, Vehicles, and Rules in Advance

segments.src: - 查看驾驶证有效期、记分情况和换证要求,临近到期的尽早预约办理。
segments.tr: - Check the validity period of your driver's license, penalty points, and renewal requirements. If it is nearing expiration, make an appointment to handle it as soon as possible.

segments.src: - 车辆的年检、保险到期时间也建议做一次核对,通过“交管12123”等官方应用可查询相关信息。
segments.tr: - It is also recommended to verify the expiration dates for vehicle annual inspections and insurance. You can check relevant information through official apps like "Traffic Management 12123".

segments.src: - 关注所在地对新能源车辆的号牌、充电、补贴和使用的最新安排,以当地公告为准。
segments.tr: - Pay attention to the latest local arrangements regarding license plates, charging, subsidies, and usage for new energy vehicles; please refer to local announcements.

segments.src: - 年末临近元旦、春节,提前了解购票、退改签规则,并确认身份证件在有效期内,避免临行受阻。
segments.tr: - With New Year's Day and the Spring Festival approaching, understand the ticket purchasing and refund/change rules in advance, and confirm that your ID documents are valid to avoid travel disruptions.

segments.src: ## 三、数据安全与个人信息:一次“账号大扫除”
segments.tr: ## III. Data Security and Personal Information: A "Spring Cleaning" for Accounts

segments.src: 近年来,个人信息保护、数据安全方面的要求持续完善。作为个人,年底是做一次信息梳理的好时机:
segments.tr: In recent years, requirements for personal information protection and data security have continued to improve. As an individual, the end of the year is a good time to organize your information:

segments.src: - **清理不再使用的 App 与账号**:注销长期不用的账户,减少个人信息暴露面。
segments.tr: - **Clean up unused Apps and accounts**: Deactivate accounts you no longer use to reduce the exposure of your personal information.

segments.src: - **检查授权**:在手机系统设置中查看各应用的定位、通讯录、相册、麦克风等权限,关闭不必要的授权。
segments.tr: - **Check permissions**: Review the location, contacts, photo album, microphone, and other permissions for each app in your phone's system settings, and turn off unnecessary authorizations.

segments.src: - **更新密码与验证方式**:对重要账户(支付、邮箱、社保、公积金)使用高强度且不重复的密码,并开启二次验证。
segments.tr: - **Update passwords and verification methods**: Use strong, unique passwords for important accounts (payment, email, social security, housing provident fund) and enable two-factor authentication.

segments.src: - **提高防诈骗警惕**:年底“退款理赔”“积分兑换”“社保异常”等名义的诈骗多发。凡涉及转账、验证码、屏幕共享的要求,一律先通过官方电话核实;可关注国家反诈中心提示。
segments.tr: - **Stay vigilant against fraud**: Scams involving "refunds," "points redemption," or "social security anomalies" are frequent at the end of the year. For any requests involving transfers, verification codes, or screen sharing, always verify through official phone numbers first; you can also follow alerts from the National Anti-Fraud Center.

segments.src: - **妥善处理旧设备**:旧手机、电脑转手前,先备份并彻底恢复出厂设置。
segments.tr: - **Properly handle old devices**: Before selling or giving away old phones or computers, back up your data and perform a full factory reset.

segments.src: ## 四、社保与民生:账户、待遇与缴费别遗漏
segments.tr: ## IV. Social Security and Livelihood: Don't Miss Accounts, Benefits, and Payments

segments.src: - 通过当地人社部门官方平台或国家社会保险公共服务平台,查询参保状态、缴费记录和个人权益,发现异常及时咨询。
segments.tr: - Check your insurance status, payment records, and personal rights through official local human resources and social security platforms or the National Social Insurance Public Service Platform. If you find any anomalies, consult them promptly.

segments.src: - 灵活就业人员和城乡居民参保人员,需留意当年的缴费截止时间,避免漏缴影响后续待遇。
segments.tr: - Flexible employees and urban/rural residents should pay attention to the annual payment deadlines to avoid missing payments, which could affect future benefits.

segments.src: - 部分地区要求领取待遇人员按期完成资格认证,可通过线上渠道办理,请留意当地通知。
segments.tr: - Some regions require benefit recipients to complete eligibility certification on time. This can often be done through online channels; please pay attention to local notifications.

segments.src: - 城乡居民医保通常有集中缴费期,请留意所在地的缴费时间和标准。
segments.tr: - Urban and rural resident medical insurance usually has a centralized payment period; please pay attention to the payment time and standards in your area.

segments.src: - 熟悉异地就医备案流程,出行或长期居住外地前提前了解。
segments.tr: - Familiarize yourself with the filing process for medical treatment in other regions, and understand it in advance before traveling or living in another city for a long time.

segments.src: - 年底可核对个人所得税 App 中的专项附加扣除信息(子女教育、住房、赡养老人等),确认信息准确、没有过期,以免影响来年预扣预缴。
segments.tr: - At the end of the year, you can verify the special additional deduction information (child education, housing, elderly care, etc.) in the Individual Income Tax App to ensure the information is accurate and not expired, so as not to affect the withholding and prepayment for the coming year.

segments.src: | 查 | 证件有效期、车辆年检与保险、社保缴费记录、个税扣除信息 |
segments.tr: | Check | Document validity, vehicle inspection and insurance, social security payment records, individual income tax deduction information |

segments.src: | 办 | 医保缴费、养老金资格认证、到期证件换领、必要的异地备案 |
segments.tr: | Handle | Medical insurance payments, pension eligibility certification, renewal of expired documents, necessary filings for medical treatment in other regions |

segments.src: | 调 | 关闭无用自动续费、清理账号与权限、更新密码、合理使用积分与余额 |
segments.tr: | Adjust | Cancel useless auto-renewals, clean up accounts and permissions, update passwords, use points and balances reasonably |

segments.src: 政策调整并不遥远,它往往体现在一张证件、一笔缴费、一次授权之中。与其等问题出现再补救,不如趁年末花一点时间做个系统梳理。**以官方发布为准、保留好凭证、保持理性判断**,就能把新变化带来的不确定性降到最低,从容迎接新的一年。
segments.tr: Policy adjustments are not far away; they are often reflected in a document, a payment, or an authorization. Instead of waiting for problems to arise and then trying to fix them, it is better to take some time at the end of the year to do a systematic review. **Rely on official releases, keep your vouchers, and maintain rational judgment** to minimize the uncertainty brought by new changes and calmly welcome the new year.
